name: Corroding Basket
description: Draw and cut upward at a high angle with the blade rising toward the open sky.

name: Gust Counterguard
description: Track the opponent's blade with a fixed gaze and turn it aside at the last moment.

name: Bellyflash
description: Step up and forward on the ball of the foot as if lifted by a rising current.

name: Blistering Swipe
description: Turn in the air or on the ground like a hawk banking and slash across the foe's flank.

name: Falsedge Fortitude
description: Flash the edge high to draw the eyes up then cut low along the opposite line.

name: Torrent Basket
description: Roll over the shoulder under a cut with the blade held high to cover the head.

name: Intent Flourish
description: Chain a dive cut and a rising counter and a clutch thrust as one stoop and recovery.

name: Unrelenting Swell
description: Spin the blade overhead in a domed guard of qi that turns blows from above and the sides.

name: Wrathful Skimmer
description: Plunge from a height with qi gathered at the point so the cut pierces guard and armor in one stroke.

name: Blazeyelman
description: Open with two cuts in turn from the edge and the back edge to test both lines of guard.

name: Chime Counterguard
description: Mirror the opponent's cut with a parry on the same line and turn it back along the spine.

name: Bellyruin
description: Thrust beside the opponent's blade along the second line while the first stays occupied.

name: Siltbelly
description: Step in a measured pair of paces that keeps both lines covered as the body moves.

name: Whirl Devastation
description: Cross from one court's line to the other mid cut so the stroke lands from the unguarded side.

name: Equipoise Falsedge
description: Rebuke a cut with a parry of the forte and a cut of the back edge together.

name: Slantcut Havoc
description: Cut and hook the back edge behind the opponent's blade to hold it on one court's line.

name: Basketwrath
description: Cut along two courts' lines at once so a single stroke carries both paired arcs through the guard.

name: Intentwhirl
description: Judge the guard with a parry then a cut then a thrust in paired order each answering the last.

name: Hellish Gallop
description: Land two cuts from both courts at once so the guard collapses under the paired strokes.

name: Rumble Spinecurve
description: Cut in a circle along the rim of a basin with the arm sweeping level at the hip.

name: Pipeback Mettle
description: Settle low with the blade held across the body so blows sink into the guard.

name: Unseen Swipe
description: Slide sideways on the soles keeping the weight low as water running to the lowest point.

name: Whirlscourge
description: Pour qi into the edge and slash so the cut releases its charge at the moment of contact.

name: Murk Basket
description: Rise from low guard with the blade to lift a descending cut up and away.

name: Sanguine Gallop
description: Drag the edge along the opponent's blade like silt and bind it low against the ground.

name: Slantcut Devastation
description: Sweep the saber in a wide flat arc that rolls across foes like a tide filling a basin.

name: Chime Belly
description: Stay perfectly still until the cut arrives then turn it and answer with an exact counter.

name: Gnashing Whirl Wrath
description: Gather qi like water in a basin and release it as one overflowing cut that breaks across every foe in front.

name: Tempered Swipe
description: Draw the curved blade in a half circle that rises and falls like a moon along the sky.

name: Unbowed Counterguard
description: Show more or less of the blade to the cut as it comes in order to turn it with the curve.

name: Hollowbelly
description: Thrust on a curved path that bends round the opponent's guard to reach the flank.

name: Gallop Glare
description: Step along a curved path to circle the opponent with the blade always pointed in.

name: Gallopspine
description: Check the opponent's blade with the curve of the edge to turn it off the line.

name: Yelmanscourge
description: Cut once short then once long so the second arc waxes beyond the first.

name: Backedge Mettle
description: Parry long then shrink the arc into a short cut that waning strikes the wrist.

name: Immobilizing Skimmer
description: Show a crescent cut then switch to its reverse so the guard follows the wrong curve.

name: Slagbelly
description: Cut a full circle around the body so the arc closes on every foe within reach of the blade.

name: Doctrine Flourish
description: Cut in a rising then falling then returning curve so each arc follows the last like moon phases.

name: Swipewrath
description: Cut with qi withheld until the last instant so the stroke arrives unseen and presses the guard down.

name: Blaze Whirl
description: Draw and cut across the opponent's front as one crosses a stream.

name: Aegis Knucklebow
description: Hold the blade along the near side like a bank and let blows run past.

name: Might Skimmer
description: Hop from foothold to foothold keeping the blade level and the weight on one foot.

name: Gnashing Belly
description: Slash in the middle of the exchange when the opponent's weight is committed.

name: Murk Pipeback
description: Pull the opponent's blade low and back in an undertow that spoils the balance.

name: Gustwhirl
description: Flick the edge so qi sprays toward the eyes while the cut follows in the same motion.

name: Hourswell
description: Chain quick cuts one after another like rapids with no gap for the opponent to answer.

name: Indomitable Yelman
description: Hold a guard like a weir that checks a rush and slows the opponent's advance to a crawl.

name: Mangling Granite Spinecurve
description: Gather a great current of qi and release it in one cut that breaks across the whole field before the blade.

name: Whirlruin
description: Draw and cut in one unbroken pass with no pause between scabbard and target.

name: Charter Swell
description: Carry the guard along one line so there is never a gap for a cut to enter.

name: Facet Falsedge
description: Thrust straight on a clear line with the whole arm and the whole body behind it.

name: Silt Slantcut
description: Move at an even pace so the blade never loses its place in the line.

name: Iron Basket
description: Cut and step in a rolling motion that never stops the edge from moving.

name: Evergreen Belly
description: Wheel parry into riposte in one rotation of the wrist so the blade is never idle.

name: Falsedge Ruin
description: Bite the curve of the blade into a limb and pull so the strike and bind are one motion.

name: Reverberating Flourish
description: Chain cut and thrust and parry without a break until the opponent's guard has no gap left.

name: Thorn Backedge
description: Hold a pale blue veil of qi along the blade that guards and strengthens the next cut.

name: Glint Swipe
description: Cut along a single line that turns aside any blade in the path and pierces the guard behind it.

name: Lacerating Spinecurve
description: Beat the blade down in a stroke like a wing and cut as it falls.

name: Swell Fortitude
description: Fold the blade in close to the body to cover the ribs and arm.

name: Nova Swipe
description: Thrust the point forward like the tip of a pinion to catch an opening.

name: Phantom Knucklebow
description: Tilt the body and the blade together and slide along a curved path into a cut.

name: Mightyelman
description: Rake the edge lightly across the opponent's hand to break the grip without a deep cut.

name: Unconquered Basket
description: Rise on the toes and lift the blade to throw an incoming cut above the head.

name: Slag Slantcut
description: Spread both arms and sweep the saber in a wide arc that cuts all foes within the span.

name: Swellhavoc
description: Strike with the saber and guard with the sweep of the other arm in one wing beat.

name: Basketflash
description: Blink forward along the line of the stroke as the blade falls so the cut lands where the foe thought safe.

name: Mightwhirl
description: Cut along the steel track with the body moving through the blade's line.

name: Inexorable Counterguard
description: Guard along the qi track by sending a pulse down the arm to the forte.

name: Siltbasket
description: Step so that the feet and blade arrive on the same line at the same beat.

name: Gnashing Yelman
description: Slash with steel on one line and qi on the other to cut where the steel does not reach.

name: Equipoise Knucklebow
description: Parry with steel while a pulse of qi staggers the opponent's grip.

name: Gust Flourish
description: Cross steel and qi over the opponent's blade and bind it at the point of crossing.

name: Lot Whirl
description: Chain a steel cut then a qi cut then a thrust along both tracks without pause.

name: Hoarfrost Pipeback
description: Hold both tracks as a double guard of steel and qi that no single cut can pass.

name: Booming Yelman
description: Join steel and qi at the point and drive them through the guard in one piercing stroke.

name: Might Backedge
description: Draw the saber with the wind at the shoulder and cut as the oath is spoken.

name: Torrent Spinecurve
description: Hold the sworn line and turn a cut aside without giving ground.

name: Brutalizing Gallop
description: Thrust along the line of the wind with the body leaning to follow.

name: Yelmanglare
description: Step as if pushed by a gust and let the blade follow the body's line.

name: Tempered Gallop
description: Slash with qi carried on the edge as a gust is carried on the air.

name: Belly Fortitude
description: Parry with a gust of qi at the forte that jars the opponent's weapon off its line.

name: Corroding Swipe
description: Hook the curved blade round the opponent's arm and bind it with a pull like a gale.

name: Multiplying Skimmer
description: Chain draw and cut and thrust on the held line with a gale of qi behind each stroke.

name: Hoarfrost Swell
description: Hold a veil of wind qi along the edge that blunts blows and gives the next cut force.

name: Swellscourge
description: Cut along the sworn line with a gale of qi at the edge that rends the guard apart.

name: Gallopruin
description: Draw into the wind on the plateau and cut with the gust at the back.

name: Evergreen Counterguard
description: Plant the feet against the wind and hold the blade across the chest.

name: Weighty Pipeback
description: Thrust down from the high ground to the chest or throat of a lower foe.

name: Swellwrath
description: Step to the rim and cut down with the gale blowing over the edge at the foe.

name: Murk Falsedge
description: Parry with an upward lift like a cliff wind that throws the cut skyward.

name: Swellruin
description: Slash low to throw dust from the ground into the opponent's eyes before the next cut.

name: Daybreak Skimmer
description: Sweep the blade flat across the plateau in a storm of qi that cuts all within reach.

name: Indomitable Basket
description: Turn a blow aside with the blade held to the wind and counter before the gust fades.

name: Blaze Slantcut
description: Gather the gale on the plateau and release it through one stroke that rends all before the edge.

name: Ferocious Gallop
description: Draw and cut in plain view with the blade lit by open sky and nothing hidden.

name: Flintlike Backedge
description: Hold the guard sworn beneath the open sky with the point forward.

name: Glintgallop
description: Thrust along a clear open line with no feint and no cover.

name: Mightbelly
description: Walk toward the foe at a steady pace with the blade low and plain to see.

name: Overbearing Whirl
description: Check the opponent's wrist with the off hand while the blade guards the centre.

name: Hellish Pipeback
description: Slash in a wide plain arc with qi held steady along the edge.

name: Chime Swell
description: Parry with the blade held openly to meet the cut and turn it aside.

name: Sanguine Spinecurve
description: Hook the curved edge round the guard in the open and pull the opponent's arm wide.

name: Swipescourge
description: Cut on a long open stride that carries the body past the guard before it can close.

name: Hour Flourish
description: Chain plain cuts in the open one after another with held qi so each stroke is seen and still lands.

name: Thorn Knucklebow
description: Hold qi still along the blade as a veil that guards and strengthens in the open.

name: Iron Falsedge
description: Cut in full view with the oath behind it so the opponent cannot step away from the stroke.

name: Rumble Counterguard
description: Cut along a bearing held steady against the wind from the start of the draw.

name: Aegis Belly
description: Hold the bearing square to the wind with the blade angled across the line.

name: Swipevortex
description: Slide the feet along the bearing so the blade keeps its heading through every step.

name: Lacerating Whirl
description: Shift the bearing a few degrees as the cut begins so it lands where the guard has not moved.

name: Equipoise Counterguard
description: Parry on the bearing so the blow turns aside along the same heading as the wind.

name: Grievous Basket
description: Lock the opponent's blade on the bearing with the spine and press until the grip yields.

name: Hourgallop
description: Cut on three bearings in turn with a gale of qi at the back of each stroke.

name: Adamantine Yelman
description: Hold the bearing against any push with a steady stream of qi along the whole blade.

name: Lacerating Gallop
description: Cut along the held bearing with wind qi at the point so it pierces whatever lies on the line.

name: Yelmanhavoc
description: Draw the saber in a sworn motion that ends in a cut at the nearest line.

name: Belly Durance
description: Half draw the blade and hold it as a guard with the scabbard braced in the off hand.

name: Glintwhirl
description: Thrust the point out as the blade leaves the scabbard to reach a close target.

name: Silt Yelman
description: Walk forward with the saber half drawn and ready to complete the stroke at any step.

name: Granite Skimmer
description: Draw then turn on the heel so the slash arrives from behind the opponent's guard.

name: Gust Backedge
description: Parry with the half drawn blade then complete the draw as a counter cut.

name: Blaze Flourish
description: Hook the edge into the opponent's guard on the draw and pull the weapon aside.

name: Yelmanwrath
description: Chain draw and cut and re-draw so the scabbard seems never to leave the hand.

name: Unassailable Pipeback
description: Hold a veil of qi between blade and scabbard that guards the hand and primes the next draw.

name: Blazeswipe
description: Gather qi in the scabbard and release it in one great draw that cuts through the guard.

name: Hellish Flourish
description: Cut in a long reaching stroke with the whole arm and the gust behind the blade.

name: Charter Basket
description: Hold a short tight guard near the body with the blade angled and the elbow in.

name: Berserk Swipe
description: Thrust at full reach with the gust pushing the body along the line.

name: Rampaging Skimmer
description: Cut long while taking only a short step so the stroke lands without losing balance.

name: Torrent Swell
description: Parry in a short tight arc that turns a long cut aside with little motion.

name: Granite Gallop
description: Bind the opponent's blade with a sudden gust of qi along the spine as the cut lands.

name: Hour Knucklebow
description: Alternate a long gale cut and a short oath guard so reach and defense never break.

name: Adamantine Spinecurve
description: Stand sworn in a short guard with qi along the blade until the foe falters.

name: Eviscerating Sanguine Swipe
description: Cut long on the gale and recover short on the oath so the stroke guards as it lands.

name: Iron Whirl
description: Cut from the windward side so the gust adds its weight to the blow.

name: Obdurate Swell
description: Hold guard with the wind against the face and the blade slanted to take the blow.

name: Vengeful Whirl
description: Thrust from the windward side with the gust speeding the point.

name: Bellyglare
description: Step to take the windward side of the opponent and keep it through the exchange.

name: Mayhem Swipe
description: Check the opponent's step from the windward side so they must turn into the gust.

name: Gallopwrath
description: Slash and turn to hold the windward side as the opponent circles.

name: Knucklebow Durance
description: Parry on the leeward side where the wind has less force and shift back to windward.

name: Baskethavoc
description: Hook the blade from the windward side and pull the opponent's arm into the gust.

name: Intentyelman
description: Chain cuts from the windward side so each carries the gust further into the guard.

name: Facet Yelman
description: Hold a veil of wind qi on the windward side of the blade that guards and strengthens.

name: Bellyhavoc
description: Cut from the windward side with the whole gust behind it so the guard is pressed down and held.

name: Might Flourish
description: Draw into the storm and cut at once with the gust driving the blade.

name: Facet Basket
description: Hold fast in the storm wind with the blade braced across the body.

name: Brutalizing Falsedge
description: Thrust into the storm with the point leading and the body crouched low.

name: Titanic Skimmer
description: Rise from a crouch into a slash that gathers the storm's force along the edge.

name: Gust Falsedge
description: Parry with quick hard strikes like hail that rattle the opponent's grip.

name: Rumble Slantcut
description: Hook the blade into the opponent's guard and wrench it with a storm gust of qi.

name: Intent Spinecurve
description: Chain cuts in the rhythm of a storm front until the opponent's guard gives.

name: Hoarfrost Counterguard
description: Hold storm qi along the edge as a veil that guards the hand and charges the next stroke.

name: Tempered Belly
description: Gather the full storm in the blade and loose it in one great cut that scours the ground before it.
